Class NlsMappingRegistry

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.nls.NlsMappingRegistry
public final class NlsMappingRegistry extends Object
Registry of the module-contributed inputs to the NLS key-mapping contract of NlsKeyMapper.

Each module that participates ships one descriptor at "META-INF/grafiosch/nls-mapping.properties". The registry reads every such resource visible to the class loader and unions the declared values, so a module extends the contract by adding a resource file rather than by executing registration code.

That matters for correctness, not only for convenience: the comparable existing mechanism BaseConstants.PREFIXES_PARAM is populated from a @PostConstruct method, so any check that does not boot the Spring context would see an incomplete registry and would therefore verify a mapping that differs from the one the running server applies. Reading the descriptors from the class path gives the runtime and the build-time guards byte-identical inputs with no ordering requirement.
